lines.text: Every problem on this board is real, unsolved, and stated properly.
Open one. Why it matters, with the numbers. What it must not break. And how you would know it worked.
A hypothesis here is not a comment. Claim, mechanism, assumptions, admitted unknowns, and a way to test it.
Supporting and contradicting evidence sit side by side. Neither one is hidden.
New to all of this? The courses are free, and they need no account.
A lesson is written in the same notation as the board. Every claim carries its kind, and the publication it came from.
Then it checks you. A wrong answer costs nothing — the explanation is the point.
No points. No streaks. Nothing here earns reputation.
And it ends where it should: on a real open problem you can now go and read.
